Marta S

Do not miss it!!
Jan 2025 • Family
The best dinner in Vietnam after 10 days of vacation! Every dish was well-kept, balanced and freshly cooked with great ingredients. There was then a rarely quiet atmosphere to be in Tam Coc in the centre, just a stone's throw from the main street, but sufficiently secluded to enjoy a cens in greater silence. The cozy name is really spot on because unlike the other overcrowded and hyper touristic places, here you really feel "pampered" by the enormous friendliness of the always smiling host. Finally, prices are absolutely average with the rest of the premises: 23€ for 4 people with beer, coke, 2 types of rolls, 2 courses of noodles, duck, 2 courses of vegetables, a salted coffee (Vietnamese specialty), a lassi and a smoothie + watermelon as a gift. The only downside maybe is the wait a bit long, but it was absolutely worth it!
